name: flags
meaning: COLLBOX_* bits: 1 non-solid, 2 cone, 4 ellipsoid, 0x10 cylinder; on the mover any of 0x16 enables shaped tests

name: min
meaning: min corner (x, y, z); object-local in the object's box list, world after Box_Translate

name: max
meaning: max corner; +0xC = maxY = bottom (Y points down)
